Follow the Leader For the Teacher : • Select a leader. • Ask the leader to give instructions. • The children follow the instructions. • The child who skips the instructions will be the next leader. Instructions : • Blink your eyes. • Shake your hands. • Tap your knees. • Pull your ears. • Touch your shoulders. stand hand turn leg Next leader clap leader Example : m at  at me n  me r ice  ice stand  __________. down  __________. around  __________. your  __________. clap  __________. blink  __________.
